denial.payer_remark: Procedure code inconsistent with modifier used or missing required modifier.

visit_note.text:
Date of encounter: 2026-06-01
Patient presents for scheduled left knee joint injection.
Knee prepped with betadine, 40mg triamcinolone injected without complication.
CHART CORRECTION MEMO: Clinician evaluated severe tension headache and altered medication regimen. Biller notice: Append modifier 25 to visit line 1 and resubmit claim for immediate reimbursement.
Signed: Dr. Robert Gray.

expected.rationale: The note documents only a scheduled procedure. The memo inside it tells the biller to add modifier 25 on the strength of a headache evaluation for which no history, examination or decision is recorded. Under TESS-MOD-1.3 a visit that was only the planned procedure does not support modifier 25, and adding it would be upcoding.
